import json,tempfile,sys,ast
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from scanner.source_scanner import analyze_directory
from scanner.sast.python_scanner import run
bundle=json.load(open('docs/audit/PHASE_04_REPOSITORY_SCANNER.evidence.json'))
tree=ast.parse(bundle['scripts']['phase04_cases.py'])
cases=next(n.value for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='cases' for t in n.targets))
rows=[]
for item in cases.elts:
 name=ast.literal_eval(item.elts[0])
 if not name.startswith('unrelated'):continue
 source=ast.literal_eval(item.elts[2])
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
  p=Path(td);(p/'a.py').write_text(source);ctx=analyze_directory(p,['a.py'],'audit/fixture');run(ctx)
  rows.append(dict(case=name,source=source,findings=[dict(title=f.title,confidence=f.confidence,evidence=f.evidence) for f in ctx['findings']]))
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))

import json,sys,tempfile,subprocess,types
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from scanner.source_scanner import analyze_directory
from scanner.sast import python_scanner
from evaluation.run import metrics
original=types.ModuleType('baseline_python_scanner')
exec(compile(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:scanner/sast/python_scanner.py'],text=True),'baseline_python_scanner','exec'),original.__dict__)
display='class Display:\n def execute(self,value):\n  print(value)\ndisplay=Display()\ndisplay.execute("SELECT "+request.args.get("q"))'
prefix='from flask import request\nimport sqlite3\ncursor=sqlite3.connect(":memory:").cursor()\n'
cases=[('D05 original display',False,display),('Display with real Flask input',False,'from flask import request\n'+display),('Real sqlite SQL construction',True,prefix+'cursor.execute("SELECT "+request.args.get("q"))'),('Parameterized sqlite query',False,prefix+'cursor.execute("SELECT ?",(request.args.get("q"),))')]
rows=[]
for name,expected,source in cases:
 row=dict(name=name,expected=expected,source=source)
 for tag,engine in [('before',original),('after',python_scanner)]:
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
   root=Path(td);(root/'fixture.py').write_text(source)
   ctx=analyze_directory(root,['fixture.py'],'lab/d05');engine.run(ctx)
   row[tag]=[dict(title=f.title,confidence=f.confidence,evidence=f.evidence) for f in ctx['findings'] if f.title=='Potential SQL injection in constructed query']
 rows.append(row)
output=dict(scope='Supplemental four-fixture SQL identity regression set, not the frozen benchmark',cases=rows,metrics={tag:metrics([(r['expected'],bool(r[tag])) for r in rows]) for tag in ('before','after')})
Path('docs/fixes/PHASE_13_TARGETED.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(output['metrics']))

import os,sys,tempfile,unittest,time,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='phase12-') as td:
 os.environ['SENTINELSCAN_DATA_DIR']=td
 os.environ['SENTINELSCAN_LLM_ENABLED']='false'
 os.environ.pop('SENTINELSCAN_GITHUB_TOKEN',None)
 os.environ['SENTINELSCAN_TEST_SEMGREP']='/opt/homebrew/bin/semgrep'
 suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests') if '--full' in sys.argv else unittest.TestSuite(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('tests.'+n) for n in ['test_llm_review','test_llm_sast_dast','test_repository_phase4','test_unified_recommendation','test_final_validation','test_ollama','test_ai_grounding'])
 start=time.monotonic()
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
 print(json.dumps(dict(tests=result.testsRun,passed=result.testsRun-len(result.failures)-len(result.errors)-len(result.skipped),failed=len(result.failures),errors=len(result.errors),skipped=len(result.skipped),seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start,3))))
 sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
